snippet.title: Into the Unwell Official Trailer | #TheIndiePremier
snippet.description:
Whack-and-slash your inner demons in a third-person roguelite inspired by a surreal rubber-hose cartoon fever dream. Play solo or with up to two friends as a cast of deeply flawed misfits.

Developed by She Was Such A Good Horse and published by Coffee Stain Publishing.

Learn more about the showcase here: theindiepremier.com
